scripts.still: bun build.ts && slopcamera html still --input out/scene.json --at 3,8,11,15,19.5,24,28,33,37.5,42 --output out/stills
scripts.still:portrait: bun build.ts --aspect 9:16 && slopcamera html still --input out/portrait/scene.json --at 3,8,11,15,19.5,24,28,33,37.5,42 --output out/portrait/stills
scripts.dry-run: bun build.ts && slopcamera html render --input out/scene.json --dry-run --json
scripts.render: bun build.ts && slopcamera html render --input out/scene.json --json > out/export.json
scripts.render:portrait: bun build.ts --aspect 9:16 && slopcamera html render --input out/portrait/scene.json --json > out/portrait/export.json
scripts.deliver: slopcamera html deliver out/export.json --basename xcb-launch --poster-at 11 --social-at 19.5 --cuts 1:1 --per-beat-clips --beats out/beats.json --output out/deliver
scripts.deliver:portrait: slopcamera html deliver out/portrait/export.json --basename xcb-launch-vertical --poster-at 11 --social-at 19.5 --per-beat-clips --beats out/portrait/beats.json --output out/deliver-vertical
